{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
table = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract values explicitly
email_rate = table['email']
paid_search_rate = table['paid_search']

difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Print the difference value only, as it is the key evidence
# This must be the only printed value to ensure it is machine-checkable
print(difference)"}
